Name: Edit Stable Ownership
Author: PredoNexus
Description:
[size=5][b]Description:
[/b][/size]
This mod allows the host to change the ownership of a stable. This is particularly useful in situations where the host has acquired more than one stable, preventing other players from being able to use items such as the “horse flute” to call their respective horses.

[size=5][b]Usage:
[/b][/size]
As a host, press ([b]Shift + Right click[/b]) on the floor of a stable to change the ownership. After that, [b]the new owner must interact with the horse[/b] to change his name and use it properly.

The key bind is configurable trough [b]Generic Mod Config Menu.

[/b]
